registeredAssertions.scenarioInputsBoundToRegistration: The test sources solar values from syntheticInputs.dailyEnvironment.scenarioSolarRadiationMJm2Day and asserts the four case IDs and values exactly match expected.cases before stepping.
observedAssertions: Known zero solar produced zero DM gain and unchanged canopy/harvestable pools without the registered unavailable-solar qualification.
Both positive synthetic solar arms matched preregistered interception, DM-gain, and pool expectations within the frozen one-step 1e-12 arithmetic bounds; the higher input produced the higher gain.
Explicit null solar remained unavailable despite DLI=18, preserved both pools, and emitted the registered missing-solar qualification.
All four arms had exactly equal gddAccumC, biomassFrac, floweringFrac, and stage; maturity endpoint equality was represented through biomassFrac >= 1.
Frozen production inputs, all shared daily environment fields, DLI, and total-pool closure were checked.
